我开心的一天(My Happy Day): 说话者用简单英语介绍自己的一天与喜好。
We often go to the bookstore together.
We talk about science a lot.
I often play tennis after class.
The living room is not far from my home.
Her husband teaches maths at my school.
column3: 她丈夫在我学校教数学。
